description: This is a shell script used for testing the 'advise' functionality in a Git environment. It contains a series of test cases that verify if advice messages are appropriately shown or suppressed based on various configuration settings.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a specified description.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files or strings.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or verifies Git configuration variables for testing.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Simulates or invokes the 'advise' tool to produce advice messages.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Defines cleanup actions to run after tests conclude.
